text: It progresses about the same. It's just, again, how the athlete feels, how good the athlete is getting, and how they're doing the rest of the things in their life. Overall, it just progresses like any progression of a program. The progressions might be 3%, 5%, depending on the muscle, how tired they are, and a lot of things, but it can progress week by week by 10%. That's way too much. It's hard to sustain a program like that for an 8-week program. Sometimes you make jumps and you have potentiation, so we have to assume that everything progresses the same, but it's all independent of the athlete and what's a good average for that.
